title: Signal Lost
summary: Orbital Station ISS-7 goes silent in deep space. Specialist Reyes is ejected from the outer airlock, sealed from the bridge console.
briefing: ISS-7 Deep Space Orbital Station, 2089. Communication with Earth suddenly severed 6 hours ago. Specialist Gabriel Reyes was found dead inside Airlock 3—ejected into the vacuum of space. The automated airlock sequence was overridden from an internal command console. The remaining 4 crew members are locked down in orbit. Remote investigators must analyze timestamped security camera feeds, telemetry logs, and biometric data to catch the killer before orbit decays.
mechanicDescription: Replay timestamped camera feeds across modules between 02:00 and 03:00 UTC to track crew movements.

locations.name: Airlock 3 (Crime Scene)
locations.description: Warning lights flash amber. The inner seal is depressurized. Frost coats the reinforced glass observation portal.

hotspots.name: Manual Override Keypad
hotspots.description: The emergency manual lever was bypassed electronically. The command originated from Terminal-01 on the Bridge at 02:42 UTC.

hotspots.name: EVA Suit Storage Bay
hotspots.description: Specialist Reyes's suit was missing its primary oxygen valve—tampered with prior to the airlock cycle.

locations.name: Command Bridge
locations.description: Holographic displays glow with emergency telemetry. Earth communication array shows total signal jamming.

suspects.name: Commander Yuri Volkov
suspects.description: 48, Station Commander. Stares intensely at orbital telemetry maps.

dialogueOptions.text: Why is the Earth comms array offline?
dialogueOptions.response: Solar flare interference knocked out the high-gain dish at 01:30 UTC. I issued an station-wide radio quiet order.

dialogueOptions.text: We decoded an encrypted Earth Directive command on your terminal.
dialogueOptions.response: That directive was CLASSIFIED! Earth ordered the termination of Project Bio-Genesis immediately!

hotspots.name: Terminal-01 (Commander's Desk)
hotspots.description: Encrypted sub-space message from Earth Orbit Command ordering immediate quarantine and destruction of bio-samples.

locations.name: Crew Living Quarters
locations.description: Zero-g bunks, personal lockers, and shared dining galley.

suspects.name: Engineer Kofi Asante
suspects.description: 36, Chief Station Engineer. Wipes grease off his cybernetic arm.

dialogueOptions.text: Did you perform maintenance on Airlock 3 recently?
dialogueOptions.response: I calibrated the pressure seals yesterday at 14:00 UTC. Everything was nominal until someone logged into Terminal-01 tonight.

suspects.name: Lt. Sarah Park
suspects.description: 29, Navigation Pilot. Checking EVA suit suit diagnostics.

dialogueOptions.text: Were you scheduled for EVA duty tonight?
dialogueOptions.response: Reyes took my shift because I had a fever. If I had gone out there... it would be ME dead right now!

hotspots.name: Reyes's Bunk & Datapad
hotspots.description: Personal audio log: 'Volkov received secret orders from Earth. He's going to purge the lab. I'm backing up the data.'

locations.name: Biological Research Module
locations.description: Centrifuge tubes, containment incubators, and glowing bio-samples.

suspects.name: Dr. Mei Zhang
suspects.description: 42, Chief Xenobiologist. Adjusting microscope laser frequency.

dialogueOptions.text: What were you and Reyes researching?
dialogueOptions.response: A synthesized cellular repair enzyme! Earth Command wanted it suppressed because it neutralizes radiation sickness treatment patents!

dialogueOptions.text: Security logs show Commander Volkov arguing with you at 02:15 UTC.
dialogueOptions.response: He threatened to lock me in stasis if I didn't hand over the hard drives! Reyes stood up to him!

hotspots.name: Bio-Lab Camera Feed #4
hotspots.description: Timestamp 02:35 UTC: Commander Volkov uses master keycard to steal Reyes's bio-data drive while Reyes was in Airlock 3.

locations.name: Fusion Reactor Room
locations.description: Plasma conduit hums with high frequency energy. Warning monitors flash signal jammer active.

hotspots.name: Sub-space Comms Relay Panel
hotspots.description: A hardware signal jammer was inserted directly into the relay by Commander Volkov's personal biometric cipher tag at 01:30 UTC.

locations.name: ARIA AI Server Core
locations.description: Glass server columns bathed in pulsing blue LED light.

hotspots.name: AI System Audit Log
hotspots.description: Un-deletable core record: At 02:42:10 UTC, Commander Volkov issued command OVERRIDE_AIRLOCK_DEPRESSURIZE on Terminal-01 to silene Specialist Reyes.

clues.name: Bridge Airlock Command
clues.description: Airlock 3 ejected Reyes via Terminal-01 override.

clues.name: Sabotaged EVA Suit
clues.description: Reyes's oxygen valve was loosened prior to airlock cycle.

clues.name: Solar Flare Claim
clues.description: Volkov claims solar flare caused signal outage.

clues.name: Classified Earth Directive
clues.description: Earth ordered Commander Volkov to destroy bio-lab research.

clues.name: Kofi Seal Check
clues.description: Kofi confirms airlock seals were normal before manual override.

clues.name: EVA Shift Swap
clues.description: Reyes took Sarah's shift last minute due to her fever.

clues.name: Reyes Audio Log
clues.description: Reyes recorded Volkov planning to purge bio-data.

clues.name: Bio-Breakthrough
clues.description: Dr. Zhang's research threatened Earth pharma patents.

clues.name: Volkov Threats
clues.description: Volkov threatened Zhang & Reyes with stasis lock.

clues.name: Cam Feed #4 Proof
clues.description: Volkov recorded stealing Reyes's drive during airlock cycle.

clues.name: Biometric Jammer Tag
clues.description: Hardware jammer planted by Volkov's personal biometric key.

clues.name: ARIA Core Audit
clues.description: Un-erasable system log showing Volkov executed depressurization.

solution.explanation: Commander Volkov received a classified directive from Earth to destroy Dr. Zhang's bio-research. When Specialist Reyes discovered the secret order and backed up the data to expose it, Volkov jammed station comms, sabotaged Reyes's suit, and executed the airlock depressurization command from Terminal-01 on the Bridge.
